title: Nigerian Wedding Photographer Nottingham Civil Wedding
description: Looking for a Nigerian wedding photographer in Nottingham? Cameraboss — award-winning British-Nigerian photographer John Lekan Durojaye — captures Yoruba, Igbo, Ghanaian, and multicultural weddings across Nottingham and the East Midlands with cinematic, culturally fluent photography. Full-day packages from £1,500. Serving couples UK-wide.
